content:
I just saw Terence’s blog post, and this sounds like a really good idea. I am working on an adjacent project where we are trying to document mathematics from the axioms through to current research in both rigorous, human-readable, and Lean form.

The idea is to give mathematicians a frontend to interact with - think GitHub + wiki + social - and an API backend for things like mathematical research with LLMs and automated Lean formalisation.

The website is https://androma.org I would love to explore some sort of collaboration if possible.
